burnout.lateHour.source: Workplace wellbeing policy: check-outs after this hour count as late nights
burnout.lateHour.note: Late nights are counted over 14 days.

burnout.maxLateNights14d.note: More than 3 late nights in 14 days is a burnout signal.

burnout.maxWeekendDays28d.note: Working more than 2 weekly-off days in 28 days is a burnout signal.

burnout.maxDaysWithoutLeave.note: No leave taken for more than 90 days is a burnout signal.
